title: Elevated-Temperature Tribo-Corrosion Response of Eutectic High-Entropy Alloy.

recollection.structure: Likely a microstructure with eutectic phases
recollection.mechanism: Interaction of wear and corrosion processes at elevated temperatures
recollection.results: Possibly quantitative data on wear rates, corrosion rates, and synergistic effects at different temperatures

score.note: The recollection only restates broad concepts apparent from the title: elevated-temperature tribo-corrosion of a eutectic HEA, a generic eutectic-phase structure, and wear–corrosion interaction. It omits the specific thermal-shock and sliding conditions, L12/B2 lamellar structure and phase stability, temperature-dependent wear mechanisms, comparator behavior, and all numerical results.
